bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AUDC issues AUDD natively on every tracked chain (Stellar, Ethereum, Solana, XDC, Base, Hedera, Redbelly, XRPL). Current issuer controls include an Ethereum ProxyAdmin-owner Safe, Stellar and XRPL 3-of-7 signing arrangements, a Solana SPL multisig and a Hedera issuer contract. XRPL's master key is disabled, but an active SignerList preserves native issuance capability; the earlier locked-account conclusion is superseded. These tracked tokens are native issuer deployments, not third-party bridge representations.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)
